title: Solving modulo a power of q by an essentially smooth Artinian algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], $\mathfrak q\subset\Lambda$ a prime ideal, $n\ge1$ an integer and $E\subset\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ a finite subset ($\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ the localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]). Then there are an integer $m\ge0$ and a homomorphism of $k$-algebras $\varphi:k[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to\Lambda$ with the following properties, where $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ and $P=k[y_1,\dots,y_m]_{\mathfrak p}$: (1) $\mathfrak q\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}=\mathfrak p\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ and the induced map $P\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (2) there is a factorization $P/\mathfrak p^nP\to D\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ of the induced map by local homomorphisms of local Artinian rings, where the first arrow is essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map] and the second is flat; (3) every element of $E$ lies in the image of $D\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo, line 2552), Section 07FF; its proof uses Lemma Tag 07FG (lemma-helper)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-flat-coordinates] to choose the admissible $A$ containing $E$, coordinates $\varphi$, their localized flat map $\psi$, the extended-ideal equality, and coordinate residues spanning $\Omega_{F/k}$.

proof.text: The quotients of $P$ and $L$ by the nth powers of their maximal ideals are local Artinian by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-quotient-artinian-local]. In Lean this is proved from Mathlib: the power is proper for $n\ge1$, so the quotient is nontrivial and local by quotient surjectivity; its radical is the maximal ideal, which is its unique minimal prime, so the Noetherian quotient is Artinian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-etale-quotient-map] to the fixed coordinates and subalgebra to obtain the local étale map $f$ into $A$ and the compatibility equation.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo); read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH

proof.text: Construct $D=\operatorname{ULift}(A)$ and transport $f$, localness, Artinianity and étaleness along the explicit ring/algebra equivalence. The inclusion $A\to B$ is flat by admissibility [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra]. Its localness follows from contraction of the maximal ideal and the image-of-maximal-ideal identity for the quotient. Compose this inclusion with the equivalence $D\to A$ to obtain the local flat $g$. An étale algebra is smooth; for [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], choose the smooth model $D$ and its localization at the submonoid $\{1\}$, with the canonical algebra equivalence. The compatibility equation for $gf$ is unchanged under the equivalence. For each $e\in E$, its explicit witness is the lift of the subtype element $(e,h_E)$ of $A$. This proves all clauses.
